title: A level 5 wizard's stored health, mana, gold and level show on the HUD, in the backpack and on the character sheet
notes: The run seeds a level 5 Fire wizard with 900 experience and a character_stats row holding 1234 gold, 300 health
and 10 mana, below the 503 health and 24 mana its school's level 5 row gives, so every number the client shows
can only have come from the database.
The game server builds the wizard's stats from that row and the level tables it extracted from the install itself,
logs what it put in the wizard's WizGameStats, and sends them in the wizard's own object in MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE.
Once the wizard stands in Ravenwood the run shoots the HUD, then opens the backpack with B and the character
stats with C, the keys the client's own InputBindings.xml gives ToggleInventory and ToggleCharStats, and shoots each.
The rest follows enter-world: the chatter the client sends entering the world is answered or allowed, and the
wizard must still be connected at the next keepalive.
Opening the backpack sends MSG_PLAYERWIZBANG, which asks the server to show other players the icon over the wizard's head;
that waits for the milestones that show other players, so the run allows it.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
